using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.HuggingFace;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Tests.Connectors.HuggingFace

    public class HuggingFaceServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_WithModel_AddsServiceAndResolvesLoggerFactory()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
            services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(loggerFactory);

            // Act
            services.AddHuggingFaceImageToText("test-model", apiKey: "key", serviceId: "myService");

            var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

            // Assert
            var imageToTextService = provider.GetService<IImageToTextService>();
            Assert.NotNull(imageToTextService);

            // The service should have been constructed with the logger factory from the provider
            // We cannot directly assert the logger factory inside the service, but we can assert the service is not null
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_WithEndpoint_AddsServiceAndResolvesLoggerFactory()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
            services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(loggerFactory);

            var endpoint = new Uri("https://example.com");

            // Act
            services.AddHuggingFaceImageToText(endpoint, apiKey: "key", serviceId: "myService");

using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.HuggingFace;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.ImageToText;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Tests.Connectors.HuggingFace
{
    public class HuggingFaceServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_WithModel_AddsService()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            services.AddSingleton<Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILoggerFactory>(NullLoggerFactory.Instance);

            // Act
            var returnedServices = services.AddHuggingFaceImageToText("test-model", apiKey: "key", serviceId: "myService");

            // Assert
            Assert.Same(services, returnedServices);

            var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

            // The service is registered keyed, so resolve by serviceId
            var imageToTextService = provider.GetService<IImageToTextService>();
            Assert.Null(imageToTextService); // Default resolve returns null because keyed registration

            // Instead, resolve keyed service by serviceId
            var keyedService = provider.GetServiceByKey<IImageToTextService>("myService");
            Assert.NotNull(keyedService);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_WithEndpoint_AddsService()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            services.AddSingleton<Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILoggerFactory>(NullLoggerFactory.Instance);

            var endpoint = new Uri("https://example.com");

            // Act
            var returnedServices = services.AddHuggingFaceImageToText(endpoint, apiKey: "key", serviceId: "myService");

            // Assert
            Assert.Same(services, returnedServices);

            var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

            var imageToTextService = provider.GetService<IImageToTextService>();
            Assert.Null(imageToTextService);

            var keyedService = provider.GetServiceByKey<IImageToTextService>("myService");
            Assert.NotNull(keyedService);
        }
    }

    // Extension method to resolve keyed services from IServiceProvider
    internal static class ServiceProviderExtensions
    {
        public static T? GetServiceByKey<T>(this IServiceProvider provider, string key)
        {
            var keyedServices = provider.GetService<System.Collections.Generic.IDictionary<string, T>>();
            if (keyedServices != null && keyedServices.TryGetValue(key, out var service))
            {
                return service;
            }
            return default;
        }
    }
}
